title: publish_log
description: Memory block written by Agent 5.2 (Social Publisher). The organic-social publishing ledger for a marketing cycle: one entry per scheduled content_calendar slot recording how it was published (now / scheduled / held / skipped / failed) through Ayrshare (Buffer fallback), with the matched copy/visual asset ids, resolved publish datetime, mechanical formatting applied, and a footing summary. Reads: content_calendar (3.2, primary), copy_assets (4.1), visual_assets (4.2). Read by Layer 6 (6.1 Performance Analytics) for slot-level attribution. Human gate: autonomous queue executor — gate_status is always auto_approved; per-item posture lives in entries[].status.

platform.description: Ayrshare canonical platform key. Null only when a slot is skipped as out-of-scope (paid/non-social).

hashtags_appended.description: Count of hashtags placed at the end of the formatted body.

hashtags_dropped.description: Count of hashtags dropped to fit a hard platform character limit (e.g. X 280).

body_truncated.description: True if the client copy was truncated at a clean boundary to fit a hard platform limit.

slot_id.description: Id of the content_calendar slot this entry resolves.

content_ref.description: The calendar slot content_ref used to match copy/visual assets.

channel.description: The content_calendar channel, echoed verbatim (instagram, linkedin, meta_ads, ...).

format.description: Content format from the slot (reel, carousel, single_image, text, video, ...).

action.description: Dispatch action: publish_now (time reached), schedule (future), none (held/skipped/failed).

status.description: Outcome. published/scheduled = dispatched; held = eligible-but-not-ready (needs human/asset); skipped = out of scope; failed = dispatch error.

post_ref.description: Publisher (Ayrshare) returned post id. Null until/unless published or scheduled.

publish_at.description: Resolved ISO-8601 publish datetime (with offset where known). Null when not derivable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the publish time is expressed in (from the slot).

visual_asset_id.description: Matched visual_assets asset_id, if any (null for text-only posts).

final_char_count.description: Length of the final formatted post body. Null for skipped/held-before-formatting.

reason.description: Eligibility reason code for held/skipped/failed (e.g. out_of_scope_paid_or_nonsocial, slot_not_approved, missing_copy, missing_or_unfinished_visual, risk_flagged_needs_human, format_uncorrectable, dispatch_error). Null for published/scheduled.

rationale.description: One short EN sentence explaining the decision.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this publish_log run was generated. Also the reference 'now' for publish_now vs schedule decisions when no explicit now is supplied.

gate_status.description: Gate posture of this agent's OWN output. Always 'auto_approved' — Agent 5.2 is an autonomous publishing executor. Per-item posture lives in entries[].status, not here.

cycle_month.description: Marketing cycle this ledger covers, YYYY-MM. Null if not derivable from the upstream calendar.

backend.description: Social-publishing backend used (Ayrshare primary, Buffer fallback — ADR-04).

source_block.description: Which upstream block the entries were derived from. 'none' when nothing was available to publish.

entries.description: One publishing decision per content_calendar slot. May be empty only when nothing was available to publish (source_block = 'none').

alerts.description: publish_failed / needs_human / missing_asset / nothing_to_publish alerts surfaced to the operator.

by_platform.description: platform key -> count of published+scheduled posts on that platform.

notes.description: EN — assumptions, backend used, fallback notes, empty-cycle reason.
